programme.title: Newscast
programme.desc: Join BBC journalists including political editor Laura Kuenssberg, Europe editor Katya Adler, Brussels correspondent Adam Fleming and political correspondent Chris Mason in their weekly podcast discussing all of the news stories that matter to the people of the United Kingdom. The journalists know all about the stories that they're talking about - they interview the most important people involved in the stories that feature in the news. They speak of their knowledge and understanding of the news in a way that is understandable for all. Laura is often in a car in the middle of a city where big politics stories are happening. Katya, Adam and Chris are usually in the studio. They regularly talk about Brexit and what is going to happen when the United Kingdom leaves the European Union.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC,which is designed to inform you on current affairs. The BBC is aims to be a totally impartial public service broadcaster, and was established by Royal Charter. The BBC is funded by a licence fee paid by British households, and is regulated by Ofcom. They aim to create high-quality content, in order to inform and educate, but also entertain, their audience Millions of people from all over the world watch content produced by the BBC, and they are well respected as a media company. It was founded in 1922, with its headquarters in Westminster, London.

programme.title: Newsday
programme.desc: "Good Morning Asia, hello World." Join the news teams from BBC World News in London and Singapore. This live news and current affairs program is broadcast globally and focuses on all the latest news and breaking developing stories that matter around the world. The show is usually presented by Rico Hizon in Singapore and Kasia Madera in London. Broadcasting live at midnight GMT on both BBC World News and the BBC News channel, the show is broadcast in the morning in Asia and therefore is marketed as a morning show for people watching around the country. The show is often followed by Asia Business Report live from Singapore which reports on all the latest economy and business figures from the country.

programme.title: The Travel Show
programme.desc: The Travel Show is a BBC travel programme. The new programme launched in February 2014,[1] and is the immediate successor of long standing travel programme, Fast Track. Utilising a network of correspondents in London, Tokyo, Sydney, New York and Kuala Lumpur, the programme aims to provide unique insight into the world of travel. It first aired in the UK in late February, after Winter Olympics coverage, in a Friday morning slot on BBC Two. A Sunday evening slot was also added on the BBC News channel in April 2014 and BBC iPlayer.

programme.title: BBC World News America
programme.desc: News presenter Katty Kay keeps you up to date with all the latest breaking news from America and the rest of the world on BBC World News America. This world renowned news and current affairs program has been recognised for its exceptional reporting at the Emmy Awards. BBC World News America won two Emmy awards for its coverage of the conflicts in Syria and the Central African Republic. You can catch up with this award winning broadcast team as they air multiple times a day throughout the week.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: In-depth news and current affairs review of the main political and economic stories of the day, featuring robust interviews with senior government and opposition figures, business and union leaders, and analytical reports that delve behind the headlines. Regular presenters cross-examine studio guests on details of policies, priorities, actions and inactions, on a range of domestic UK and international topics. There are weekly features on the arts, sports and the world of technology, and editors are not afraid to venture into niche, specialist and exotic areas from space travel to animal psychology. If the BBC's flagship Radio 4 Today programme sets the early morning news agenda for the day, then its late-night TV equivalent often gives the people in power some sleepless nights.

programme.title: Max and the Midknights
programme.desc: Max and the Midknights go into hiding, as King Gastley's guards scour the city looking for them. When guards almost spot Uncle Budrick, Mumblin turns Uncle Budrick into a goose as a disguise. It works, but unfortunately Mumblin can't figure out how to turn Uncle Budrick back into his human form, so he's stuck as a goose. Also, Kevyn discovers a prophecy that appears to be about Max and Max learns that her dagger actually belonged to King Conrad and, due to some kind of enchantment, it glows and points the way toward King Conrad's whereabouts. Max, realizing the fate of Byjovia hangs in the balance, decides that it's up to her and the others to find King Conrad and restore him to the throne. Thus, Max and the team devise a plan to escape from Byjovia without being captured. As they make their harrowing escape, they face off with the tentacle beast and, to everyone's surprise, Millie learns that she has magical powers. Ultimately, thanks to Millie, they make it out of Byjovia to begin their quest!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora is an interactive animated series about the cheerful and enterprising young girl Dora who likes to travel through the jungle of South America with her little monkey Boots. Her father and mother live in the jungle. Dora is curious of everything and wants to know about animals, flowers and plants of the forest. When she travels she always take with her a little back with survival equipment and a singing map.

programme.title: The Adventures of Kid Danger
programme.desc: Henry Hart is a normal eighth grade student, with an out of school job that takes him on amazing adventures. His cool part time gig as Kid Danger, takes him on out of this world adventures as the sidekick-in-training to famous superhero Captain Man. They go on bizarre and crazy travels, battling criminals and villains that try to attack his hometown and Captain Man himself. Meanwhile at home, Henry has to stay in hiding, keeping his sidekick job as a secret from his best friends, Charlotte and Jasper, and little sister Piper. What exciting adventures will Kid Danger get up to with Captain Man and will be he be able to hide his alter ego from his friends and family?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When Aang and his friends go to a Fire Nation town so that Aang can witness some firebending, their plan soon goes awry when it's discovered that he is the Avatar. Fortunately, he's rescued by an individual who serves a firebending master named Jeong Jeong who has abandoned the Fire Nation, so Aang attempts to use this time to attempt to learn how to firebend. However, when the firebending master refuses to even see Aang, will Aang be able to prove he's ready to learn how to firebend despite the fact that he lacks discipline?

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Tennis: Wimbledon. Highlights Day 11
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

UFC stands for the Ultimate Fighting Championship which is an American mixed martial arts (MMA) promotion company based in Las Vegas that is owned by William Morris Endeavour.The purpose of UFC fighting was to establish the most effective martial art in a contest that had no weight classes and minimal rules that were as follows: no biting, hair pulling, groin shots and eye gouging. Legendary fighters well known for their ability to win in UFC fighting are Anderson Silva, Brock Lesnar, Connor McGregor and Ken Shamrock. programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Trying to adapt to this new world, Lay Lay learns it's not easy to blend in when you're the epitome of fierce. But with Sadie by her side, the two best friends can accomplish anything!

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover
programme.desc: Max and Phoebe start the process to impress Captain Perfect and save their mission, but they clash over their different styles. As Max sees that Phoebe worked better with Captain Perfect, he decides that he will also be better off with a new partner, and summons his friend Gideon from Hiddenville. Gideon doesn't fit the superhero mold, however, so Max uses one of his gadgets to give him size and strength. But the setting is off, and Max shrinks Gideon to the size of an ant, forcing him to locate and save his impossible-to-see friend before Phoebe and Captain Perfect discover what he's done. Meanwhile, Chloe asks Booch and Jinx to try their best to bond with new crush BC, so they pretend to be wealthy like his family.

programme.title: Henry Danger
programme.desc: Henry Danger is a story about adventures of a 13-year-old Henry Hart who is lucky to become a helpmate of a super hero Captain Man. This is a real dream job of every teen. The newbie is getting paid for fighting against crime and helping to save the world. Brave Henry must hide his job from his family and friends and it is not that simple, but nothing can stop him from being a true crime-fighter. Henry himself wants to become a super hero one day, that is why he is constantly learning from Captain Man and is not scared of any hardships on the way to his dream.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: When the Dutch peacekeeping mission in Afghanistan is nearly over, soldier Diederick dies in the arms of his 21-year-old platoon mate Johnny. Johnny comes home as coffin bearer and after the ceremony at the Eindhoven Airbase, he is being welcomed home in the bar of his parents who treat him as a hero. Johnny undergoes the welcome party passively. He doesn't feel comfortable or at home. The next day he drives with a loaded gift to Aerdenhout. The gift is a DVD containing a movie that Diederick had made for his twin sister's birthday, Fleur. He rings the bell at the ancestral home of Diederick. The loss of Diederick has put the family relations on edge. Because of his gift, Johnny is sucked into the unpredictable family struggling with their pain. Johnny sees it as his duty to help them, but he doesn't know how. To be able to come home, he must first allow himself to experience his own grief.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: While trying to beat a paddle-ball world record, SpongeBob forgets to feed Gary - for several weeks. So Gary runs away to downtown Bikini Bottom where he is taken in by a kindly old woman who confuses him with one of her many deceased pets. Once SpongeBob realizes that he has neglected Gary, he sets out in a town-wide search for him. Meanwhile, as Gary is wrapped in comfy blankets and indulged in and endless assortment of snacks, he discovers a very dark secret about this sweet old woman...

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: It's Sunday in Bikini Bottom, and all Squidward wants to do is enjoy the last few hours of "me time" before the work week begins. But SpongeBob and Patrick continue to intrude on his perfect Sunday. // When a Skill Crane is installed in the Krusty Krab, Squidward becomes obsessed with winning a stuffed animal from the machine. It's not long before he spends all of his money and the deed to his house - and still can't win.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Welcome to the Patrick Star Show hosted by Patrick himself and revolving around his extraordinary family and his own bizzare fantasies. Get to know his family, his Dad Cecil Star, his Mom Bunny Star, his sister Squidina Star, and GrandPat Star, and find out where his charm and eccentricity come from.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick hires other Patricks to entertain at parties in 'Too Many Patricks', then in 'Much Tofu About Nothing', Pat-Thos shares a Hamdonian tale of love and pork products.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Donnie's trapped in a mad scientist's lab by the Monster Mutanimals Tokka, Rahzar, Scale Tail, Antrax and Wyrm who are after Wingnut's blood. Meanwhile, Leo, Mikey and Raph try to get pizza but the shop owner is furious: they've made a mess of the place too many times! But the Turtles have never been there before! They're confused until another Tokka wrecks the place in a huge fight before exploding into ooze...and then another Tokka arrives! In the lab, Donnie plans his escape but stumbles upon a video of Rahzar who explains the Monster Mutanimals are doomed unless they find the blood of a stable mutant... and they need Donatello's help! A real-life Rahzar lunges at Donnie, who fights him off until a whole pack of Monster Mutants shows up. The other three Turtles track their Tokka to the lab but are quickly captured. Donnie can only watch as his brothers are shoved into cages... and confronted by the creator of the Monster Mutanimals, the mad scientist Jordan Perry!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: Sonic Prime
programme.desc: Sonic and the crew of the Angel's Voyage aren't the only ones after the No Place Shard-the Chaos Council co-opted Nine's Shatterdrive tech and sent Rusty Rose and a legion of Eggforcers to grab it too!

programme.title: Sonic Prime
programme.desc: In The Void, Shadow intercepts Sonic's latest Shatterspace transverse, for a personal face-to-fist encounter. Sonic assumes this Shadow is another distorted prism version of someone he knows until Shadow calls Sonic by name.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Nine-year-old twins, Jade and Mica know Marsupilimis are real, as their explorer parents entrusted them with three precious eggs that hatched into Marsups named Hope, Twister, and Punch. They now live happily with the twins and their Gran Gran Suzanne above the family restaurant The Chahuta in Palombia, whilst the Twins parents search for the Marsups family. Living with three young Marsupilamis is an endless source of adventures. Jade and Mica love having having fun with them, but know, it's essential to keep their existence hidden from the outside world to keep them safe. Every day brings new challenges - taking the Marsupilamis to the park can quickly turn into a frantic race through the sewers and a confrontation with a wild jaguar, or a game of golf can result in capture by Stan the zoologist! Jade and Mica learn just as much from these fun furry creatures as the Marsupilamis learn from them - they make a great team and family!

programme.title: Best and Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Удивительное рядом
programme.desc: На заброшенной строительной площадке в Копенгагене, где уже давно царствует природа, 47 детей обретают свободу действий. Здесь они в течение десяти недель будут ходить в школу и узнавать, чему их может научить природа. "Удивительное рядом".

programme.title: Балтия
programme.desc: Еженедельная информационная программа "Балтия" – непредвзятый взгляд на происходящее в Эстонии, Латвии и Литве. События, явления и люди в репортажах корреспондентов Настоящего Времени, работающих в регионе. Точная и беспристрастная информация, все точки зрения о происходящем в каждой из трех стран, входящих в Евросоюз и военный блок НАТО.

programme.title: Сделано в Германии
programme.desc: Программа о бизнесе с человеческим лицом. Захватывающие экономические репортажи из сердца Европы. К примеру, авторы рассказывают о рисках и преимуществах цифровых технологий в быстро меняющемся мире, а также о их влиянии на то, как мы работаем, что мы зарабатываем и как мы живем. Топ-менеджеры, креативные бизнесмены и молодые специалисты, новые тренды и традиции немецкого бизнеса - все это Made in Germany.

programme.title: Однажды в Америке
programme.desc: Это цикл фильмов об эмигрантах, снятый эмигрантом: о людях, которые покинули Украину, Беларусь и Россию после 24 февраля 2022 года. Мы показываем Америку глазами человека, которому нужно строить свою жизнь заново, искать свое место в пока еще чуждом для него мире. Сравниваем цены на продукты и топливо, говорим о политике, работе и учебе.

programme.desc: Программа "Утро" каждый будний день открывает информационную линейку телеканала "Настоящее Время". Главные новости, основные события наступающего дня, самые важные темы для обсуждения - в утренних эфирах каждый день.

programme.title: Анализируй Этно
programme.desc: Саха, или якуты, - коренной народ Северо-Восточной Сибири, проживающий преимущественно в крупнейшем регионе России, Республике Саха (Якутия). В этой серии проекта "Анализируй Этно" мы послушаем уникальный саха панк, который развивался практически в полной изоляции. Встретимся с известным антивоенным активистом - Айхалом Аммосовым. Узнаем об особенностях игры на древнем музыкальном инструменте - хомусе. Посмотрим кино с режиссеркой Людмилой Борисовой и узнаем больше о феномене саха кинематографа. А также узнаем, как жители Якутска живут в изоляции каждый раз, когда река Лена замерзает.

programme.title: Ждем в гости
programme.desc: Винный тур по Грузии всегда был самым востребованным туристическим маршрутом. И тут, конечно же, у Кахетии нет равных. Не зря этот регион Грузии называют "колыбелью грузинского вина". Но чем живет край в условиях отсутствия иностранных туристов? Зураб Двали покажет старинный собор Алаверди, расскажет о монастырском вине, побывает в гостях у знаменитого мастера глиняных кувшинов квеври и потомственных сыроваров в Телави, а также в уникальном музее марани "Нумиси" и поделится рецептом популярного грузинского соуса ткемали.

programme.desc: После начала полномасштабной войны в Украине независимая журналистика внутри России была практически уничтожена. Многие медиакоманды и журналисты оказались разбросаны по Европе и постсоветским республикам. Как им теперь строить свою жизнь? Как работать в профессии, напрямую связанной с нахождением на территории страны? Их выгнала родина, или они сами ее покинули? "Там, где нас нет". Режиссеры: Юлия Вишневец, Михаил Ратгауз. programme.title: Tiny House Hunters
programme.desc: Reality series showing American house hunters who are considering joining the tiny-house revolution where people are choosing to live in smaller homes - often less than 55 square metres -and praising their benefits. In this property series realtors present three petite houses to prospective buyers. Some of the homes would be used as permanent residences whilst others could be a retreat to escape to. There are various reasons for the trend for tiny-living; some people are doing it for financial reasons, others are trying to live more ecologically and some yearn for a simpler lifestyle. When the potential tiny-homeowners are faced with the practical limitations of the properties on offer will they take the plunge and embrace the joys of tiny living? Or will they change their minds for more spacious accommodation?

programme.title: Island Life
programme.desc: After years of vacationing on Topsail Island, NC, an NYC family is ready to start living the island life full-time. The calm and relaxing beaches are a breath of fresh air, and flexible careers are making this dream a reality.

programme.title: Island Life
programme.desc: Empty nesters who have been visiting Topsail Island, North Carolina, for more than 20 years are ready to relocate permanently. Their hometown is becoming congested, so it's the perfect time to make the move to an oceanfront condo.

programme.desc: In the 1920s a young English couple--Walter a middle class doctor and Kitty an upper-class woman--get married for the wrong reasons and relocate to Shanghai where she falls in love with someone else. When he uncovers her infidelity in an act of vengeance he accepts a job in a remote village in China ravaged by a deadly epidemic and takes her along. Their journey brings meaning to their relationship and gives them purpose in one of the most remote and beautiful places on earth.

programme.title: Waking Ned
programme.desc: The lucky winner of the national lottery is Ned Devine, so taken by his good fortune that he now can't be waked, because he died from the shock of it! News of the win spread quickly in the scenic little Irish village of Tully More, but not the secret news of Ned's demise. With lottery officials closing in to confirm the prize claimed by the deceased Devine, Ned's closest friends scheme to keep the prize money close to home, in memory of Ned of course! But as the plot twists humorously, they learn it is hard is to keep such a secret in a small town.

programme.title: The Green Perfume
programme.desc: Crime - Comedy, Premiere. After witnessing a murder on stage, an actor is drawn into a thrilling investigation across Europe, uncovering secrets and hidden conspiracies that challenge his perception of reality. (Sandrine Kiberlain, Arieh Worthalter) 2022, 101'

programme.title: The Little Witch
programme.desc: The little witch is only 127-years-old, so just a youngster to the big witches. Despite being forbidden, she celebrates the Dance of the Witches on the Brocken Mountain on Walpurgis Night. As punishment, she has one year to learn the big book of spells by heart, and then her fate will be decided. Determined to be the best witch she can, she gets down to work, supported by her talking raven, Abraxas. At first reluctantly and then increasingly, she discovers helping people instead of annoying them with pranks makes her feel good. But the big witches, especially the scary weather witch Rumpumpel, are suspicious. For them, the last thing about being a really good witch is good deeds. And this puts the little witch in a terrible dilemma when it comes to her final test.

programme.title: The Big Bad Wolf
programme.desc: The mother of Louis, Philippe and Henri Delcroix has been taken to hospital. She is in alarming condition and might well die. The possible coming of death into their comfortable lives suddenly challenges the three brothers. Are they really taking advantage of their lives? Philippe wanted to be an architect and is only a tourist guide, and although married to Nathalie their sex life lacks spice. As for Henri, he is married to Patoche, a frigid policewoman, and does not live life to the full, and couldn't Louis, the oldest and apparently the wisest of the tribe, hide something behind his blatant family and professional success?

programme.title: April And the Extraordinary World
programme.desc: April and the Extraordinary World is a 2015 French-Belgian-Canadian animated science fiction adventure film co-directed by Christian Desmares and Franck Ekinci. In 1870 on the eve of the Franco-Prussian War, French Emperor Napoleon III, accompanied by Marshal Bazaine, visits the lab of Gustave Franklin to access his project of breeding invulnerable supersoldiers. The emperor is disgusted with the results—two intelligent, talking komodo dragons ill-fit for war—and orders Bazaine to shoot them, but the creatures escape and the emperor instead causes an explosion that kills all three present. Napoleon III's successor then negotiates a settlement with Prussia to avert war, thus securing the throne to the House of Bonaparte.

programme.title: Say Cheese
programme.desc: Thierry's wife Claire wants to leave him. In a desperate effort to save his marriage Thierry ropes in Claire and the two grown-up children to spend a vacation in Greece exactly as they did on a legendary trip 30 years ago.

programme.title: The Wait
programme.desc: Amidst the large rooms of an old villa marked by time, Anna, emerging from a sudden bereavement, spends her days in solitude. The rugged and beautiful Sicilian countryside surrounds the house and isolates her while the fog, which is slowly climbing the slopes of Mount Etna, prevents the eye seeing any distance. Only the footsteps of Pietro, the handyman, break the silence. And all of a sudden Jeanne appears, a young woman who claims to be the girlfriend of Giuseppe, Anna's son. He invited her to Sicily to spend a few days' holiday together. Anna was unaware of Jeanne's existence. And Giuseppe is not there. But his things are all there, in his room. Soon, very soon he will return, is what Anna says, unable to reveal a truth that for her cannot be spoken. The days pass, the two women slowly get to know each other, and together they begin to wait for Easter, when Giuseppe will finally come home, and a great traditional procession will be held in the village.

programme.title: Allelujah
programme.desc: The Beth, a small community NHS geriatric facility in Yorkshire, is facing closure because of Whitehall budget cuts. Colin, a management consultant for the health department, arrives to visit his ailing ex-miner father and to make an appraisal. Meanwhile, the staff and patients are preparing a presentation for the formidable Nurse Gilpin, who is to be presented with a long service medal. Based on the successful stage play by Alan Bennett.

programme.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
programme.desc: In late 18th-century Brittany, painter Marianne is commissioned by an affluent countess to paint a portrait of her sheltered daughter Héloïse so that she can be appraised by a prospective suitor in Milan. A previous attempt couldn't be completed as Héloïse refused to pose for the artist, so Marianne has to finish the portrait in secret by pretending to be a companion for Héloïse, who is unhappy at the prospect of marriage to a stranger. In French with English subtitles.

programme.title: Suntan
programme.desc: Makis Papadimitriou and Elli Tringou star in Argyris Papadimitropoulos' dark drama. Kostis (Papadimitriou), a flabby forty-something physician, moves to the Greek island Antiparos to take over from his predecessor. While the winter months are bleak and quiet, the summer transforms the island into a sun-soaked paradise, pulsating with the spirit, and bodies, of its holidaymakers. One of Kostis' patients during the tourist season is Anna (Tringou) - a woman half his age, who has fallen off a quad bike. Struck by Anna's beauty, Kostis ventures to the nudist beaches to pursue her, eventually finding her with a group of friends. They allow him to join their clique, regarding his awkwardness as a source of amusement. But, when Anna responds to Kostis' growing desire, it becomes clear he doesn't share her notion of harmless fun. In Greek with English subtitles. First screening on Channel 4 (previously seen on Film4).

programme.title: Dark River
programme.desc: Ruth Wilson stars in this acclaimed drama from writer/director Clio Barnard (The Selfish Giant), inspired by Rose Tremain's novel Trespass. Following the death of her father, Alice (Wilson) returns home to Yorkshire for the first time in 15 years, to claim the tenancy of the family farm she believes is rightfully hers. There she encounters her older brother Joe (Mark Stanley), a man she barely recognizes, worn down by years of struggling to keep the farm going whilst caring for their sick father. Joe is thrown by Alice's sudden arrival and angered by her claim. Battling to regain control in a fraught and fragile situation, Alice must confront traumatic memories and family betrayals to find a way to restore the farm and salvage the bond with her brother before both are irrevocably lost. Co-starring Sean Bean. Co-funded by Film4. Network Premiere.

programme.title: The Piano Teacher
programme.desc: Erika Kohut is a piano teacher at the Vienna Conservatory prestigious music school in Vienna. In her early forties and single, she lives with her overprotective and controlling mother in a hermetically sealed world of love-hate and dependency, where there is no room for men. Her sex life consists of voyeurism and masochistic self-injury. Lonely and alienated, Erika finds solace by visiting sex shops and experimenting with masochism. Ata a recital, she befriends Walter, a handsome young man, whom she seduces and with whom she begins an illicit affair. As Erika slowly drifts closer to the brink of emotional disorder, she uses the love-stricken Walter to explore her darkest sado-masochistic fantasies, which eventually lead to her undoing.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Animal Cops: Philadelphia follows the work of the Pennsylvania SPCA's Humane Law Enforcement team as they investigate cases of animal cruelty; rescue sick and abused animals and fight for justice on their behalf. The Pennsylvania SPCA's humane law enforcement officers cover an area of over 46,000 square miles from their headquarters in Philadelphia. The six offic ers with full police powers and six agent trainees are on call 24 hours a day seven days a week protecting the city's one and a half million pets.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Philadelphia

programme.title: Guardians of Rescue
programme.desc: Follow a group of men and women coming from a range of backgrounds, united in their love for animals and in their mission to rescue them, as well as educate and motivate people to follow their lead. Their main concern is helping animals in need, but it is also strengthening the bond with animals that has always been present in human lives, emphasising the importance of nurturing that relationship.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

programme.title: The Zoo: San Diego
programme.desc: "The Zoo: San Diego" provides a behind the scenes look at the daily lives of various species of animals and the teams that care for them. Featuring two parks, the San Diego Zoo and the San Diego Zoo Safari Park, as well as the San Diego Zoo Institute for Conservation Research, San Diego Zoo Global is home to more than 700 species and 6,500 animals. A wide range of animals are introduced, including pandas, giraffes, Galapagos tortoises, koalas, elephants, mountain lions, two baby cheetahs that are learning how to be ambassadors for their species and a flock of ostriches known as the "Spice Girls." Besides the animals, the keepers and veterinarians at both the Zoo and the Safari Park -- many of whom have dedicated their lives to caring for animals, discuss what it's like to be a part of this world-renowned zoo.

programme.title: Bad Dog
programme.desc: BAD DOG! is a hilarious hour of television documenting just how far pets can push their owners and still get unconditional love. The series highlights dogs that double as destroyers, hissing cats, cussing parrots, and the most fascinating four-legged escape artists ever caught on tape. Viewers will be treated to candid animal antics you truly have to see to believe. They are some of the baddest pets on the planet and you'll meet their owners who love them just the way they are. We span the globe to crown the Baddest of the Bad on BAD DOG!.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

programme.title: The Vet Life
programme.desc: The Vet Life is an amazing series revolving around three friends, three vets, Diarra Blue, Aubrey Ross, and Mike Lavigne and their everyday lives. These guys became friends back in University, then they worked in Las Vegas and finally moved to Texas and opened a full-service veterinary hospital of their own. The series highlights their daily routine, their duties at work and at home, their families and pets.

programme.title: Treehouse Masters
programme.desc: Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: Insane Pools Off the Deep End
programme.desc: Insane Pools: Off the Deep End is a home improvement show that follows pool designer Lucas Congdon and his team from Lucas Lagoons. Congdon and his crew renovate existing pools and build new ones on residential properties. Thanks to their unbelievable imagination, creativity and professionalism they can turn every pool into an ultimate backyard oasis for a whole family and transform it into a natural lagoon. They prefer working with hand-selected stones from Tennessee.

programme.title: The Last Alaskans
programme.desc: The Last Alaskans chronicles the daily rituals of four families choosing to live in seclusion, vast distances from each other as they overcome harsh arctic conditions, frustrating setbacks, and aggressive wildlife while they survive in one of the last great unspoiled and unforgiving wildernesses on the planet. In the refuge, prop planes, canoes and dog sleds replace the modern luxuries that most people take for granted. Humans cohabit with the animal world and often share the same emotions and struggles while they discover that they are not necessary at the top of the food chain. Utilizing an authentic and organic approach to document the weeks leading up to and during the winter season, The Last Alaskans sets a distinctive and vibrant tone unlike any other docu-series before to completely immerse the viewer into a world that would otherwise be lost in history.

programme.title: I Was Prey
programme.desc: Nature's great predators are animals you don't want to come across, especially when you find yourself in their own backyard. In this heart-pumping documentary series, individuals share their stories of encounters with dangerous animals, reliving the frightful, life-threatening ordeal. With stories from across the world, we reveal the heart-in-mouth moments when these lucky individuals managed to escape the jaws of death. From a swimmer mauled by a bull shark in the Bahamas to a close shave with a grizzly bear in the mountains, these stories showcase the fearsome power of predators.

programme.title: Scaled
programme.desc: Scaled is a documentary show following reptile-lover Greg West and his team, as they make custom terrariums and cages for reptile-owners across America. Those who are not fans of traditional fluffy pets want to create one-of-a-kind habitats for snakes, skinks, agamas or frogs. The unique ideas for creative design of Greg are turned into reality in the show. Meet these extraordinary animals and their owners, as the team of Cornel's World make their environment more special.

programme.title: Rugged Justice
programme.desc: Animal Planet's Rugged Justice follows the officers from Washington State's Department of Fish and Wildlife Law Enforcement as they guard the vast borders. It is an elite unit that protect people and wildlife, patrolling coastal areas, mountainous terrains and rugged roads of rainforests. Every day brings a new challenge, dispatchers receive around 25.000 calls annually, every of which requires prompt reaction.

Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Dinner: Impossible
programme.desc: Robert Irvine is ready for any challenge he is challenged to overcome culinary obstacles and deliver a delicious meal before his time runs out. With new challenges from this exciting, fun-loving chef, viewers will see if Robert can make dinner, possible!

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: Two talented chefs go head-to-head for the chance to Beat Bobby Flay. To get to Bobby the chefs must first face off against each other, creating a spectacular dish with a secret ingredient of Bobby's choice. Judges Alex Guarnaschelli and Jeff Mauro know Bobby's strengths and his weaknesses. Their goal: Pick the chef who has the skills to take down Bobby Flay in his own arena. The winning chef gets to challenge Bobby with his or her surprise signature dish. If Bobby goes down, the winner can tell the world, "I beat Bobby Flay!"

programme.title: Giada at Home
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis is an outstanding culinary specialist, the author of nine New York Times bestselling cookbooks, Emmy award winning television personality and the host of Giada at Home television show. Giada has quite an impressive background of culinary training from Le Cordon Bleu in Paris, which combined with her own unique Californian charm creates her one-of-a-kind recognizable style. In Giada at Home she focuses on cooking at home for friends and family for different occasions and on party planning. Holiday feast or romantic dinner, weekend vibes or average day, it does not matter- the food is always delicious.

programme.title: Selena + Restaurant
programme.desc: Selena Gomez and Raquelle head to Alta, Chef Keith Corbin's California soul food restaurant. For the kitchen initiation, Corbin puts Selena under pressure with some short order egg cooking, and she quickly learns it's not nearly as simple as it sounds. Once she's proven her mettle, Selena attempts to make a fried fish dish tasty enough for Alta's menu and the restaurant's toughest critic, Renee Corbin.

programme.title: Selena + Restaurant
programme.desc: Selena Gomez finds a taste of home as she tries the best Texas barbecue in Los Angeles at Moo's Craft Barbecue. Husband and wife team Andrew and Michelle Muñoz challenge Selena to create a dish that puts her own spin on their meat-centric menu. She decides to create a unique sausage containing the flavors of one her most favorite guilty pleasure foods! Selena and Raquelle quickly find themselves in over their heads as they realize that they have no idea how sausages are made. The stakes get even higher when Nana and Papa show up, two native Texans ready to see if Selena's dish can make the grade and the menu!

programme.title: BBQ Brawl: Flay V. Symon
programme.desc: Join our hosts, renowned celebrity chefs and restaurateurs Bobby Flay and Michael Symon, as they test the skills of eight expert barbecue connoisseurs. Filmed at the Star Hill Ranch in Austin, Texas, the eight chefs are divided into two teams but, in order to claim first pick for their team, Bobby and Michael go head-to-head in a backyard BBQ challenge. Each episode sees one of the chefs being eliminated from the show until there is only one left, the winner who is awarded the title of 'Master of Cue'. The weekly contests aim to reveal the chefs' talents and expose their weaknesses and include tasks such as cooking up a tomahawk rib-eye and taking on a Texas beef challenge.

programme.title: Summer Baking Championship

programme.desc: While Josh, Chad and John are down at base camp prepping the dredge to move to the upper lake, Eric and the Red Zone team are pulling out rubies by the scores, but it's a hard-won success. With food supplies almost nonexistent and weather turning from bad to worse on a dime, the team is mustering all its strength to make this venture a success. John desperately wants to see the rubies on his 50th birthday, so he makes a foolhardy hike to the Red Zone with more than 50 pounds of reindeer meat on his back. It's a dangerous trek never before done by any human, and with the wrong intentions, he puts the team at severe risk with his choice to redeem himself. Meanwhile, Eric gets a bad case of ruby fever and successfully ventures farther and deeper into the Red Zone. The miners find a deposit a hundred times better than their first and confirm they could be sitting at the epicenter of the largest ruby band in the world. They find one particular ruby worth $200,000, but with ruby fever in full swing, the team members begin to mistrust themselves and each other. Eric tries to take control but ends up breaking the ruby that could have paid for the whole season. The group's low morale is saved when John arrives with reindeer meat, but time and weather are forcing them to leave the Red Zone in two days. In the mad rush to take care of business, the team begins to unravel again, and adding John into the mix only stirs the pot worse.

The six-part series follows eight men who leave behind their families, friends and homeland to strike it rich against all odds while struggling to survive against the harshest of conditions. Greenland's a veritable beast, but the motley crew of ICE COLD GOLD miners is up for the challenge. Each thinks he has what it takes to walk away with gold, rubies and sapphires before winter and large mining companies swoop in. What transpires as the miners cope with the unpredictable, harsh unknown? Are they humbled by their journey? Do their personalities get in the way? Most importantly, do they strike ICE COLD GOLD?ed ice sheets.

This series features compelling interviews and behind-the-scenes information of some of the internet's most viral crime clips.

programme.title: Southern Fried Homicide
programme.desc: Across the Deep South, heat, humidity and darn good hiding places provide a perfect backdrop for dark, despicable deeds. Southern Fried Homicide transports viewers into the steamy, Southern subculture whose lifestyles and charming drawls are captivating viewers - and covering up crimes. SOUTHERN FRIED HOMICIDE probes the juiciest stories from down in the Bible Belt, from the Carolinas to Louisiana and Tennessee. The premiere episode on June 5 at 10/9C profiles an old adage in the south: families are a bit like fudge - mostly sweet, but with a few nuts. After pedigreed Southern belle Susie Newsom's marriage fails, sweet Susie spirals and starts to have an affair...with her disturbed first cousin. When the rest of the family isn't exactly thrilled with the kissing cousins, their scandalous relationship ends with nine family members dead, spanning from Kentucky to North Carolina. SOUTHERN FRIED HOMICIDE proves that ugliness lurks behind Southern beauty when cracks in moral society give way to cold-blooded murder. Actress Shanna Forrestall, a native belle of Louisiana, serves as the gatekeeper to these salacious stories that give another meaning to things that "go south."

programme.title: Street Outlaws
programme.desc: Reality series focuses on the amazing opportunity to dive into American street racing world. Look at how need for speed unites people and find out what adrenaline addicts are ready for in Oklahoma, unofficial capital of illegal street racing. programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Buy, repair and restore and then resell a classic car in order to make profit- this is what Wheeler Dealers is about. The budget is limited, though you can see some exclusive and rare cars. Mike Brewer, a British dealer chooses the car carefully and hands it over to the mechanic, first Edd China, later Ant Anstead to be fixed and upgraded. The hosts are real masters of their trade, it seems they can bring life even to a piece of metal. It does not matter if you are a life-long car enthusiast or do not even have a driving license you will admire the results of hard work from the beginning to the end of the long uneasy restoring process.

In this property series realtors present three petite houses to prospective buyers. Some of the homes would be used as permanent residences whilst others could be a retreat to escape to. There are various reasons for the trend for tiny-living; some people are doing it for financial reasons, others are trying to live more ecologically and some yearn for a simpler lifestyle. When the potential tiny-homeowners are faced with the practical limitations of the properties on offer will they take the plunge and embrace the joys of tiny living? Or will they change their minds for more spacious accommodation?

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

The show will showcase the endearing couple who are all set to welcome a set of triplets while raising the elder 11, their ages ranging from 2 to 14. While Karen and Deon both have always wanted to have a big family, a ménage of 14 is not exactly they'd wished for. With both having inherited a gene pool that boasts a lineage of multiple births, the show will portray how the family celebrates and embraces all of life's hurdles and drama with open arms.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. programme.title: Scrapyard Supercar
programme.desc: Petrolhead Shane Lynch is setting two teams of amateur mechanics a task of epic proportions; they have just four days to build monster machines that can out-perform a "top-trump" attribute of a supercar! Under the expert guidance of head-engineer Ralph Hosier, theyve got free reign in an automotive scrapyard to build their vehicles, before going head-to-head on the racetrack to see which performs best. Through the teams trials and tribulations, we will learn how supercars work, and learn just how hard it is to achieve perfection. From acceleration to braking, handling to grip, this is a true test of beauty vs beast. Scrapyard Supercar.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Whether you're trying to get to the head of the class, earn the big promotion, or just find a parking spot - every day, you're competing. With yourself… and with others. So what is it about the human brain that makes you want to win - sometimes at all costs? In this episode we'll explore your brain and competition through a series of, well… competitions! Each viewer will be assigned a team and play along as our Red and Blue teams duke it out in a head to head battle to determine the winner of "The Brain Games" . Along the way you'll learn what drives you to compete, why some people may be born more competitive, and how a little healthy rivalry can help you climb the ladder of success. You've got to be in it to win it on Brian Games.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: In this episode youll play along with interactive games that unlock the secrets to attraction, youll learn how your brain quickly calculates whats attractive (or not), and youll discover how hidden formulas can predict whom you consider beautiful. Youll journey into the secrets of long-term relationships, and youll play along and discover just what it is that attracts two people together beyond conscious control including a shocking revelation of the one body part that can often predict compatibility. From secret formulas to brainwave patterns, youll see the mysteries of attraction revealed. Prepare to discover that beauty isnt skin deep its brain deep on Brain Games.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: This is a show about your brain and stress. Youll see how your brain manages stress and how stress also manages you. From traffic jams to screaming babies, angry bosses to bill payments, youre surrounded by stress everyday. But stress has a purpose, and youll discover why its a good thing in many situations, even though it can overwhelm you. But dont let that stress you outthere are ways to manage it! Through a series of interactive games and experiments,youll discover how stress works and how to handle it better. So sit back, relax and dont stress out…on Brain Games.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

We find out what happens when air gets into an airplane and how much huffing and puffing it actually takes to bring a brick house down.

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: When a faraway earthquake brings a Bangkok skyscraper crashing down, investigators wonder why it was the only one to fail. Was a deadly wind whipped up by the tallest tower in Yorkshire? The destruction of a Danish landmark highlights the risks of historic renovation, a Bronx building collapse shows that any renovation is risky if not done according to plan, and working with mobile cranes reveals a long history of contemporary errors.

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: The mask of Tutankhamun is one of the most famous finds of ancient Egypt, but close inspection reveals a consistent set of strange marks around all the hieroglyphs spelling Tutankhamun's name. Could the name have been engraved over top of another? In North America during World War II, strange and insidious-looking devices made of wood, rope, sandbags and gunpowder were found scattered across the northwestern USA and Canada. Who made them, and what was their sinister purpose? And in East London, a decorative clay bottle from the Middle Ages is uncovered. Not so strange, until the plug was removed and the bottle's contents revealed to include rusty nails, centuries-old human hair, fingernails … and urine. What is this sorcery?

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: Easter Island's tall stone moai have long captured the global imagination, and there are still mysteries surrounding them. Out of nearly 1,000, why is one particular moai, called Tukuturi, the only one kneeling and sporting a beard? In 1950s USA, sightings of UFOs were a national phenomenon. Alien or not, many Americans didn't realize that the US military was working their own flying saucer: the Avrocar. And just after Newton's discoveries about gravity, 18th-century German physician Franz Anton Mesmer also proposed an invisible force that he called ""animal magnetism." To harness it, he built a device from a giant wooden tub saying it could cure any illness. Patients seemed to corroborate the claim, but could it be true?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

He invented a complex-looking machine to diagnose any disease. Thousands flocked to be tested, but the establishment was skeptical. At Berlin's Neues Museum, a bust of Egypt's Queen Nefertiti portrays a woman so stunning that she has become synonymous with flawless beauty. programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: The lost colony of Roanoke is a historic mystery that has not been solved for over 400 years. An intriguing artifact was discovered in 1937: the Dare Stone. Apparently written by John White, it explains in detail what happened to the vanished colony. But is it real? World War I was the first major conflict to feature warplanes and, therefore, also the first to feature anti-air defence. How did an object resembling a satellite dish on wheels help gunners shoot down enemy planes? In Egypt, excavations of the Great Sphinx of Giza in 1817 uncovered six carved hunks of stone. Put together, they appear to be fragments of a large, braided stone beard, in the style of false beards worn by ancient pharaohs. The Sphinx never wore a beard … or did it?

programme.desc: We begin in New Orleans where construction turned to destruction during the build of a brand new Hard Rock Hotel. Delays and cost over-runs are legendary, but the collapse of the tunnel's ceiling is an infamous example of how just a few extra dollars spent on the correct adhesive could have prevented a tragedy.

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: The proliferation of heavy, oftentimes overloaded, transport truck traffic in China is having unintended consequences: the collapse of multiple roads and highways. We look at some of the most recent examples of sudden and shocking road collapses and examine the underlying causes. Next, we examine the crawler crane - the heavyweight champion of the construction industry. When things go wrong with this crane, it's a catastrophe befitting the machine. And that's what happened in Varese, Italy when a massive crawler crane installing a portion of a brand-new rail bridge toppled over. Was it the machine or operator failure?

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Three real world disasters forensically analysed and recreated in astonishing detail from expert analysis and all the evidence. How did the nuclear reactor at 3 Mile Island meltdown? How did a small truck fire in the Mt Blanc road tunnel become a lethal inferno? How did the seven year old Sampoong department store in South Korea collapse onto hundreds of shoppers?

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Disasters can strike anywhere, anytime. To find out why, expert analysis of the available evidence is used to recreate real world disasters in cutting edge 3D graphics. We can dissect them, peel back the layers, even freeze time to reveal a disaster's hidden and surprising causes – a paperwork error, a bad glue job, changing a restaurant opening hours. Whatever it is, Disaster Autopsy will uncover it.

programme.title: Mutant Weather
programme.desc: Mutant Weather takes viewers onto the front line of the shocking new weather phenomena that, thanks to climate change, are changing the world around us faster than we can keep up: terrifying elemental events with names like Dry Lightning, Thundersnow, Polar Vortexes, Firenadoes, Ice Waves and Atmospheric Rivers. Mutant Weather tells the stories of these mutations, from gestation and birth to their cataclysmic impact and how they will evolve next, using spectacular video footage, first-hand testimonies from those who've experienced them, expert scientific analysis, stunning graphics and dramatic recreations.

programme.title: Lunaraha
programme.desc: Kuldgloobusega tunnustatud põnevusmärul ärimagnaat Tom Mullenist (Mel Gibson), kelle poeg röövitakse. Mullen ja ta abikaasa (Rene Russo) nõustuvad hiiglaslikku lunaraha maksma, kuid tehing ebaõnnestub. Kurjategijate plaanid aga keeratakse päris peapeale, kui Tom paneb televisiooni vahendusel välja hiiglasliku preemia röövijate tabamiseks - elusalt või surnult.

programme.title: Liikleja
programme.desc: Mis on Eesti liikluses valesti? Mille üle saab uhke olla? Milliste reeglite vastu kõige enam eksitakse? "Liikleja" näitab, mis toimub Eesti liikluses, annab nõu ja jagab näpunäiteid, mis on elupäästvad ning muudavad liikluse Eestis ohutumaks. Eestis on registreeritud umbes 34 800 väikelaeva, mis näitab, et vaba aja veetmine vee peal on muutumas järjest populaarsemaks! Aga ka veel olles kehtivad teatud reeglid! Tänases "Liikleja" saates uurimegi, mis on väikelaevajuhtide head tavad ja kuidas tagada vee peal ohutus? Saates jagab elupäästvaid näpunäiteid Transpordiameti ekspert. Oma kogemustest väikelaeva juhtidena räägivad laulja Toomas Lunge ja näitlejanna Inga Lunge. Saatejuht on Jaanus Koort.

UFC Magazines. Countdown: Conor McGregor-Max Holloway
programme.desc: Martial Arts based TV programme. UFC stands for the Ultimate Fighting Championship which is an American mixed martial arts (MMA) promotion company based in Las Vegas that is owned by William Morris Endeavour.The purpose of UFC fighting was to establish the most effective martial art in a contest that had no weight classes and minimal rules that were as follows: no biting, hair pulling, groin shots and eye gouging. Legendary fighters well known for their ability to win in UFC fighting are Anderson Silva, Brock Lesnar, Connor McGregor and Ken Shamrock. Women's MMA has seen Ronda Rousey defend her title from 2012 to 2015 before she was defeated by Holly Holm another belt holder in more than one martial art.

programme.title: Wimbledon. Highlights Day 11
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Sheldon on vaimustuses, kui saab aidata Bernadette'il ja Wolowitzil bürokraatiaga toime tulla, aga avastab siis, et nad rikuvad seadust. Leonard on pettunud, kui ta sõbrad jätavad ta teadusprojektist kõrvale.

programme.title: Kutsuge Cobra 11
programme.desc: Saksamaa kiirteed on muutunud ühenduslüliks ida ja lääne vahel, kus liiguvad kõiksugu sorti hämarad tegelased ja eluohtlikud laadungid. Kiirteel töötavad politseinikud, kes ohtliku töö tegemisel kohtuvad päevast päeva lapseröövlite, salakaubitsejate, põgenike ja mõrtsukatega.

programme.desc: Parklas lastakse maha koeraomanik. Lisaks koera eest hoolitsemisele asuvad Ben ja Semir lahendama koeraomanikuga seotud juhtumit. Mees oli häkker, kes pidi kuritegelikule jõugule turvaseadmed välja lülitama. Matthes Weber värvatakse tema asemele. Kuigi Matthes tahab kuritegelikust maailmast eemale hoida, otsustab ta riskida ja seekord veel kurjategijatega koostööd teha.

programme.title: Simpsonid
programme.desc: Homer mängib pokkerit Broadway legendi Laney Fontaine'iga ja kaotab 5000 dollarit. Laney on nõus võla unustama, kui saab Lisa kuuks ajaks endale. Laney teeb Lisast lapstähe ning Marge ja Homer kardavad, et tegid teda ära andes vea, ja lähevad New Yorki talle järele.

programme.title: Perepea
programme.desc: Stewie suur lemmik peale ta kaisukaru Rupertit on jõulud. Kui ta kuuleb, et ostukeskuses saab jõuluvana näha, tahab ta kohale minna, et ise kingisoovid jõuluvanale edasi anda. Brian viib vastumeelselt Stewie ostukeskusesse, aga jõuluvana ei tee neist väljagi. Selle tõttu sõidavad Stewie ja Brian põhjanabale, et anda jõuluvanale õppetund jõulurõõmu osas.

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Penny proovib võrgutada seksist hoiduvat Lenoardit, et mees ei saaks annetada spermat naise endisele kallimale Zackile ja tolle naisele Marissale. Wolowitz, Bernadette, Anu ja Koothrappali lähevad tühistatud poissmeestepeo asemel "ropsikomeedi" peale.

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Kui sõbrad saavad teada, et Wil Wheaton juhib Dungeons & Dragonsi mängu, kus osalevad William Shatner, Joe Manganiello, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar ja Kevin Smith, lähevad vabale kohale pääsemise nimel käiku pettus ja reetmine.

programme.title: Johnny English asub vastulöögile
programme.desc: Seekordne seiklus saab alguse küberrünnakust, mis paljastab kõik Briti sala-agendid, muutes MI7-st erruläinud ja praegu rõõmsalt õpetaja-ametit pidava Johnny Englishi Briti valitsuse ainsaks lahenduseks. Tagasi ametisse kutsutuna hüppab English pea ees sündmuste keerisesse - tema ülesandeks saab tabada küberrünnaku eest vastutav ajugeeniusest häkker. Olles mees, kel jääb sageli oskustest vajaka ning varustatud vaid analoog-maailma meetoditega, peab Johnny English oma missiooni edukaks täideviimiseks ületama moodsa tehnoloogia poolt seatud takistused. Nimelt on asjad Johnny eelmisest missioonist saati palju muutunud - relvad ja riistad on välja vahetanud nutitelefon ning võimsad sportautod on asendunud hiirvaiksete elektriautodega. Kui alguses on English hämmingus, siis peagi leiab kõigutamatu enesekindlusega varustatud härrasmees endale omase lähenemisviisi otsustades, et parim vastane moodsa digi-kurjami maha võtmiseks ongi just temasugune täielik analoog-mees. Vana armas Aston Martin saab tolmust puhtaks pühitud, eksoskelett ja magnetsaapad välja otsitud ning koos keldrikantselei sügavustest vabastatud ustava partneri Bough'ga haarab Johnny härjal sarvist. Osades: Rowan Atkinson, Olga Kurylenko, Jake Lacy, Ben Miller, Miranda Hennessy, David Mumeni.

programme.desc: Shane otsustab proovida kõva kivimi kaevandamist ja saab abi ootamatust allikast, Mackie'd panevad üllatuskülalise tööle ning Sheryl ja Simon otsivad varuosasid, et jätkata kullaotsinguid.

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid
programme.desc: Jacqui ja Andrew suunduvad ühte Fish Creeki nurka, kuid pinnase ärauhtumine ähvardab peatada nende 40-tonnise buldooseri, ja Gold Devils proovib õnne kuluka retkega uuele maale.

programme.desc: Gold Timers võitleb kullavarastega, kuid ülitundlik detektor aitab neil kulda leida. Shane'i ja Russelli kodune kanal ei vea välja, kuid nad teevad siiski panuse ülekaevandatud maatükile.

programme.desc: Poseidon Crew püüab leida kulda enne hooaja lõppu külmade ilmade tõttu. Dust Devils paneb mängu üle 150 000 dollari, et avada uus purustamistehas. Queenslandis tegutseb uus tiim.

programme.title: Lennuõnnetuste uurimine

programme.desc: Värskelt avastatud vana kaart vastab pealtnägija tunnistuses sisaldunud vihjetele ja võib osutada, kust Slumach oma kulla leidis.

programme.title: Yukoni kuld
programme.desc: Ajaga võidu joostes alustavad PJ ja Andy öövahetusega, et enne talve saabumist lüüsida välja hooaja parimad kuldsed setted.

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid
programme.desc: Poseidon leiab pärast hinge vaakumist tõelise jackpoti. Goldtimersi hooaeg pöörab veel hullemaks, kuid Dust Devils paljastab miljonilise rahu.

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid
programme.desc: Pinged on haripunktis, kui Poseidon Crew puutub kokku mitme rikkega. Ferals lüüakse kullarikkast kohast minema, enne kui uus lepingu ajal suur saak leitakse. Gold Timers eksib aga Austraalia kõrbes ära.

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid
programme.desc: Kõrbekaevurid laskuvad kullaotsinguteks maa alla, Shane Calegari võtab kasutusele tipptehnoloogia ning Sheryl ja Simon otsivad varuosasid oma puhuri parandamiseks.

programme.title: Kollanokkadest rekajuhid

programme.title: Lennuõnnetuste uurimine

programme.title: Jäätunud kuld

programme.desc: Kui miljoneid väärt kaubaga laev on teele asumas, toimub kaos nii maal kui merel ja kipper seisab silmitsi hooaega lõpetada võiva katastroofiga.

programme.title: Esmakohtingud. Austraalia
programme.desc: Ajay ja Matti vahel tekib kohe klapp sarnase suhtlusstiili ja huumorisoone põhjal ja kuigi Ajay kõhkleb, lepitakse kokku teise kohtingu osas. Claudiat ja Jacki ühendavad austraalia släng ja Claudia armastus toidu vastu. Joshi kohmakad vihjed ei avalda Jake'ile muljet, tulemuseks on "ei". Miranda ja Peteri katastroofiline kohting saab päästetud ja Pete teenib välja ka teise kohtingu.

programme.title: Armastuse hind
programme.desc: Pärast Halisi ja Hatice avaldust, šokeerib häärberirahvast uudis Seyrani röövist. Teda üritatakse leida. Ferit kahtlustab esialgu röövis Serterit või Dorukit, ent nendega rääkimine ei anna tulemusi ja Ferit pöördub pettunult koju tagasi.

programme.title: Kodus ja võõrsil
programme.desc: Fenomenaalselt edukas ja pikaealine Austraalia draamasari ookeani-äärse väikelinna Summer Bay elanike rõõmudest ja muredest, armumistest ja südamete purunemistest. Sarja trumbiks on haaravad ja inimlikult usutavad tegelaskujud, kelle eludega on vaatajal kerge samastuda. Tegelaste galerii on ka piisavalt mitmekesine, et igaüks leiaks endale lemmiku, kellele kaasa elada - siin on nii teismelisi, noori täiskasvanuid kui ka juba küpsesse keskikka jõudnud peategelasi. Lisaboonuseks on Summer Bay igikestev päikesepaiste, mis rõhutab sarja positiivsust ja elurõõmu.

programme.title: Briti parim pagar
programme.desc: Peonädalal valmistavad pagarid viineripirukaid ja teevad beeži värvi vältiva Rootsi laua. Kelle road on poolfinaaliväärilised ja kes on tujurikkuja?

programme.title: Utta Danella - Kes suudleb doktorit?
programme.desc: Tagasihoidlik hambaarsti abiline Anna Maria Binz armastab salaja oma ülemust doktor Leander Winterit. Ootamatult palub Leander Anna Marial oma tütre pulmas tema sõbratari mängida. Anna Maria ja Leanderi vahel hakkab peagi sädemeid lendama, kuid naise ilusatele unistustele saabub lõpp, kui Leander perele pettuse üles tunnistab. Anna Maria lahkub töölt ja Leander mõistab, et tahab Anna Mariat ka päriselt oma kõrvale.

programme.title: Täitunud sünnipäevasoov
programme.desc: Oma 30. sünnipäeva õhtul soovib keskkonnakaitsja Lindsay Corwin, et kõik tema elu sünnipäevasoovid läheksid täide. Kas need soovid aga tõepoolest vastavad sellele, mida ta päriselt tahab?

programme.title: Luksuskinnisvarahaid
programme.desc: Simon ei taha valmistada pettumust kliendile, kes on armunud liiga kallisse majja. Hirm arstide ees innustab Gavinit rohkem kui kunagi varem. D'Leanne alustab meditatsiooni, kuidkas nii pingelises olukorras lahkub keegi zenina?

programme.title: Nadiya nutikad road
programme.desc: Nadiya Hussain jagab lambalihast võileiva retsepti, mille rikkalikust hakklihasegust saab valmistada samosad koos juustu, sriracha ja tortiljadega.

programme.desc: Celine'i ja Donato vahel lööb esialgu sädemeid, kuid Celine'i jahutavad maha jutud Donato Ibiza-reisidest. Danielle'i seksuaalenergia ei klapi Shauni kohmetu olekuga. Teist kohtingut ei tule. Dede vaikimine ja Charlie telefonifiasko teevad kohtingule kiire lõpu. Rhys ja Domenic leiavad ühise keele peene maitse ja tulevikuplaanide teemal. Brandoni karakter võidab Casey poolehoiu, kes nõustub ka teise kohtinguga.

programme.title: Südamed
programme.desc: Haigusest räsitud keha on kergem parandada kui murtud südant. Astu 1960. aastate Torino edumeelsesse Molinette haiglasse, kus meditsiinirevolutsiooni eesotsas seisavad tipparstid Delia, Alberto ja Cesare. Selles maailmas nõuab elude päästmine hulljulget riski ja revolutsioonilisi ideid. Kuid operatsioonisaali ustest väljaspool põimuvad kirg, reetmine ja keelatud tunded. Kui kaugele saab minna teaduse nimel ja mis juhtub siis, kui armastus hääbub? Saa osa haaravast ja emotsionaalsest meditsiinidraamast, kus iga südamelöök loeb.

programme.title: ERR.ee uudised
programme.desc: Eesti Rahvusringhäälingu uudised - Eesti ja kogu maailma kõige värskemad uudised.

programme.title: Loomarahva TV
programme.desc: Merisutt on angerjat meenutav kala, kellel on suus 12 rida hambaid! Need hirmuäratava välimusega tegelased on maailmas elanud juba 450 miljonit aastat - dinosauruste aegadest saati.
